artworks.label: Tidal sea urchin
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for obsidian-tide. One natural black sea urchin with elegant fine obsidian-dark spines, subtle turquoise tidal-water highlights between its spines, tiny ivory foam beads at its lower edge, resting on one small wet basalt sliver. Premium fine-art coastal macro photography, realistic wet marine texture and restrained sea-glass refraction, obsidian-black/deep-teal/ivory palette. No spiral shell, vortex, pebble garden, wave sculpture or rectangular shore panel. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
